transfer.title: Transfer request for order {id}
transfer.intro: You've received a request to transfer ownership of your order ({id}). If you agree to this request, you can approve the transfer by clicking the button below.
transfer.acceptNote: If you accept, the new owner will take over all responsibilities and permissions associated with this order.
transfer.ignoreNote: If you do not recognize this request or wish to retain ownership, no further action is required.
transfer.acceptedText: Order {id} has been successfully transfered to the new owner.
transfer.acceptError: There was an error accepting the transfer. Please try again.
transfer.declinedText: Transfer of order {id} has been successfully declined.
transfer.declineError: There was an error declining the transfer. Please try again.
